mapper.select: SELECT homepage_id, writing_idx, participation_field, writing_type, user_name, school_name, school_year, user_phone, protector_phone, user_email, postcode, address_base, address_detailed, approval_status, delete_yn, add_id, add_date FROM WRITING_CONTEST WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND delete_yn = 'N'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WRITING_CONTEST WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND delete_yn = 'N'
AND ${search_type} LIKE '%'||#{search_text}||'%'

SELECT homepage_id, writing_idx, participation_field, writing_type, user_name, school_name, school_year, user_phone, protector_phone, user_email, postcode, address_base, address_detailed, approval_status, delete_yn, add_id, add_date FROM WRITING_CONTEST WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND writing_idx = #{writing_idx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WRITING_CONTEST ( homepage_id, writing_idx, participation_field, writing_type, user_name, school_name, school_year, user_phone, protector_phone, user_email, postcode, address_base, address_detailed, approval_status, delete_yn, add_id, add_date ) VALUES ( #{homepage_id}, (SELECT NVL(MAX(writing_idx), 0)+1 FROM WRITING_CONTEST), #{participation_field}, #{writing_type}, #{user_name}, #{school_name}, #{school_year}, #{user_phone}, #{protector_phone}, #{user_email}, #{postcode}, #{address_base}, #{address_detailed}, #{approval_status}, #{delete_yn}, #{add_id}, SYSDATE )
